name: 993 dashboard trim, composite skin with load-path (bionic) inner ribs, vehicles without passenger airbag, gyroid core (PicoGK)
material_candidate: organic matrix composite, fibre and resin to be determined
picogk_enhancement: Gyroid core: the published PicoGK body (bionic_topology) keeps its outer form; a 2.25 mm skin encloses a sheet gyroid (16.875 mm cell, 1.875 mm wall) wherever the body holds three cells, thinner zones and functional features stay solid, drain ports run to the nearest outer surface and any pocket they miss is filled solid. Core settings are assumptions for the composite class; nothing here is printed, depowdered or tested.

cell_mm.note: gyroid period; at least 9 walls so the channels stay open to the drains

wall_mm.note: gyroid sheet thickness; class minimum 1.0 mm, at least 2.5 voxels

skin_mm.note: outer skin; class minimum 1.5 mm, at least 3 voxels

min_cells.note: owner rule 2026-10-22: core only where three cells fit, else solid

drain_d_mm.note: powder/resin drain diameter; class minimum 3.0 mm

max_drains.note: lowest and highest core points, then farthest-point spread

reapply_bionic_features_note: bionic.json lists tiled design regions, not features; the published PicoGK body already carries every opening, and the skin wraps all of them
open_interfaces: SCOPE: M564 (no airbag) or Carrera RS 'without Airbag' only; never on an M561/M562 car
instrument hood, air vents, steering column, glovebox, console junction, pillars and windscreen base - not measured
